entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
The name is Mike Smith. Order number is VF778-0199. I expect a full refund, no questions asked. I've had it with this thing.

Thank you, Mike. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 18 days ago on January 3rd. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It doesn't matter! I don't like it, it doesn't work the way I thought, and I want to return it. Are you going to help me or am I going to have to speak to your manager? I'm already looking at your website to leave a review.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can definitely help you with this. I'm just checking our current return policy for your item right now.

Okay, I've confirmed everything on my end. It looks like your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. So you can do it? It's not a problem?

Not a problem at all. Since you're within the 10-day timeframe, it's a very straightforward process. I've just initiated the return, and I'm sending the prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Okay... good. So I just print that out and send the band back?

That's correct. Just place the sensor back in its original packaging, attach the label to the box, and you can drop it off at any local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
You're very welcome, Mike. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
